body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 0397dd1b4148ec74801a5ff6534349440eb09fc9 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocking finding. This is the first review of this PR.

Reviewed head `0397dd1b4`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `db3bb1f7f`. The merge is clean.

## Review tier

This is not a safety-tier review. The diff changes one UI pane, its tests and one decision record. It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, the stock simulation or geometry.

## What looks good

- "Use for this setup" and its "Cannot assign" text are now below the machine list, outside the two scroll areas (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/machines_pane.rs:250-271`).
- The button and the double-click queue the same command, `CommandKind::UseCatalogueMachine`. The UI writes no field directly. Undo restores the previous machine.
- The double-click reads `assign_block` of the row that the user clicked (`machines_pane.rs:234`). A refused machine or the mounted machine queues nothing.
- The refusal reason is read after the selection and filter changes of the same frame. The old code read it before them.
- The "Selected: <name> - not yet this setup's machine" line uses the same comparison as `assign_block` (`mount_path` against the mounted path).
- The pane makes no new work for each frame: `assign_block` ran one time for each frame before this change also.
- `machines_pane.rs` has 330 lines. The new tests are in their own module (145 lines) with a provenance line and a Gate map.
- The body has before and after screenshots. They are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, not on the PR branch. I looked at the two images: the button is hidden before and visible after, at the same scroll position.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3776`. The commit subject is conventional. `docs/decisions/3776-machines-assign.md` records the decision.
- No snapshot PNG, golden, `.nc` or `.cl` file changed.

## Results, merged with main (built locally, macOS)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed |
| `ui suites: lib` | 1542 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool` | each suite passed |
| The five pins in `egui_app::tests::machines_pane::assign` | 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` | 0 steps reached, 105 skipped: the diff reaches no heavy lane |

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no test data and no import code. It does not change posts, operations, motion or the catalog, thus I did not run `example_catalog` again.

## Mutations (I ran them again)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Production file from `upstream/main` with the tests of the PR | red: `selected_machine_names_the_unapplied_selection`, `assign_button_works_after_details_scroll_to_bottom_and_undo_restores`, `double_click_assigns_the_clicked_machine_and_undo_restores`, and also `double_click_uses_the_clicked_rows_guard_and_skips_the_mounted_machine` |
| Remove only `&& e.assign_block(&state.world).is_none()` at `machines_pane.rs:234` | red: `double_click_uses_the_clicked_rows_guard_and_skips_the_mounted_machine` (`assign.rs:107`) and `double_click_refused_machine_does_not_queue_an_assignment` (`assign.rs:140`) |
| The fix restored | green: 14 of 14 `machines_pane` tests |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `machines_pane.rs:252` - The button is now also active while the machine file editor is open. Before this change, the editor hid it. The decision record says that this position is intended. The command validates the file on disk, thus I see no hazard. No test pins this state.
2. `assign.rs:122-144` - The refused-machine test removes its temporary file only when all assertions pass. A failed run leaves one small file in the temporary folder.
3. The body says "Fetch upstream before the final quick gate: `1ed0898d3`". Main is now at `db3bb1f7f`. I ran all steps against that main, and they are green.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
